paragraphs: On Friday, a postcard came to the house near the park. It was from Aunt Sue, Mom's younger sister. The picture on the front showed a green mountain. Lily read it to Tom and Mom at the kitchen table. "Dear Lily and Tom, Hello from the mountains!

I am on a short holiday with a friend. Our room at the hotel is small, and it has a big window. The first morning was very foggy. There was fog everywhere, and I could not see the road. We drank hot tea and waited for the sun. At ten o'clock, the fog went away. Then I saw green hills and a small lake. Before lunch, we walked by the lake. The air was cool, and it smelled of wet grass.

In the afternoon, I went to my old college. The college is on a hill, and it has a lovely garden. I studied there to be a nurse. My teacher still works there, and she was very happy to see me. We had a cup of tea in her small office. She asked about my work at the hospital.

The next day, a big storm came. The rain was heavy, and the night was very noisy. I could not sleep because of the noise. My friend and I played cards in the hotel. In the morning, the storm stopped, and the frogs were noisy, too! Then the sun came out, and the hills were green again. For dinner, we ate sticky rice and mango, and it was delicious. I bought this postcard at the post office near the hotel.
How is Pip? I miss you all. Please send a photo of Pip, and give Grandma a hug for me. Say hello to Dad for me. I will see you soon. Big hugs, Aunt Sue"
text.summary: A postcard from Aunt Sue comes to Lily and Tom. Aunt Sue tells about her short holiday in the mountains, the foggy morning, her old college, a noisy storm, and the delicious food.
